endorsements.name: Türk Telekom
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-0020
endorsements.description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Palo Alto Network Cortex XSOAR web interface enables an authenticated network-based attacker to store a persistent javascript payload that will perform arbitrary actions in the Cortex XSOAR web interface on behalf of authenticated administrators who encounter the payload during normal operations. This issue impacts: All builds of Cortex XSOAR 6.1.0; Cortex XSOAR 6.2.0 builds earlier than build 1958888.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.8)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.
